description: Stereo four-pole ladder low-pass filter, with a drive that can be taken into distortion

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, 22Hz at one end and 16384Hz at the other
Sets the resonance, from none up to self-oscillation at the top of its travel
Attenuverts the FREQ input before it moves the cutoff, -1 to +1
Boosts the signal by up to eight times; on the linear setting the boost comes after the filter, and on the non-linear setting it is how hard the signal is driven into each stage
Switches between a linear ladder and a non-linear one that runs each stage through a saturating curve

inputs.text: The left channel going into the filter
The right channel going into the filter
Moves the cutoff frequency, scaled by the F.MOD knob and with no effect while that knob is centred
Adds to the resonance, 5V taking it from nothing to full
Adds to the gain, 5V taking it from nothing to full
